pages.summary: Robin se acomoda en su silla. El primer viaje en automóvil de Pansy se convierte en una conversación sobre motores.

panels.scene: At the curb while the SUV is parked, Jane gently finishes settling Robin into the padded car seat. She uses only two visible hands, one supporting his shoulder. The baby is clearly safely seated, with a navy sweater, bare hands, and smooth human skin. Pansy looks on from outside, face intrigued.
panels.caption: Los Granger habían preparado un lugar para Robin.

panels.scene: Inside the parked car, close two-shot Pansy sitting upright with her own seat belt drawn across wool coat; Hermione points at the buckle with one hand from her side, distance maintained. Robin in the rear-facing seat visible between them, not on a lap. No overlapping arms.
dialogue: Pansy: Podía hacerlo sola.
Hermione: Por supuesto.

panels.scene: View from the curb of the graphite SUV moving through London winter lights at dusk. No people framed close. Wet paving, bus silhouette, passing terraces and early festive shop lights.
panels.caption: Las calles empezaron a deslizarse tras la ventanilla.

panels.scene: Pansy watches with fascinated green eyes from the left rear passenger position, belted, one hand relaxed on her own knee. Malcolm's eyes in mirror toward road.
dialogue: Pansy: ¿A qué velocidad vamos?
Malcolm: A unos cuarenta kilómetros por hora.

panels.scene: Small graphic cutaway showing stylized visual comparison only, vintage sports car on a road and polished wood racing broom silhouetted in the sky. Separate with reflected glass to make the analogy explicit. No people, no traffic stunt.
dialogue: Pansy, fuera de cuadro: ¿Hay autos que superen los trescientos kilómetros por hora?
Malcolm, fuera de cuadro: Algunos.

panels.scene: Warm composition from front toward rear safely framed, Pansy smiles with new interest, Hermione's brown eyes look at her across the visible deep shell of Robin's seat. Malcolm smiles toward road seen in small mirror, no extra steering wheel.
dialogue: Pansy: Por fin algo del mundo muggle tiene sentido.

pages.summary: Jane y Pansy descubren su interés por Florencia. La conversación distiende el viaje hasta la casa de los Granger.

panels.scene: Inside moving SUV seen in cropped shoulder-up close shots. Jane turns her chin from front-left passenger seat toward rear, warm profile. Pansy in back looks interested, charcoal coat and forest scarf.
dialogue: Jane: También estuvimos en Florencia. Me pasé horas en la Galería Uffizi.

panels.scene: A cinematic memory insert of Florence at golden hour: stone museum colonnade and distant cathedral dome, no readable lettering, no extra speaking people.
dialogue: Pansy, fuera de cuadro: Los frescos son mucho más impresionantes en persona.

panels.scene: Back in same car, Jane in warm passenger profile with sage scarf. Hermione and Pansy in rear look toward one another, the rear-facing seat shell between them. No overlapping hands.
dialogue: Jane: En casa tenemos una biblioteca. Tendré que prestarte algo de Jane Austen.

panels.scene: Close view of Hermione's face by side window, burgundy coat and cream scarf, platinum sapphire at front. Street lights and window reflections behind.
dialogue: Hermione: Me gusta verte con ellos.

panels.scene: Wide shot of the stationary graphite SUV in the driveway of the exact two-storey Victorian house. Hedges and pale brick, glowing bay windows, wreath on dark green door. One soft column of chimney smoke. The small distant figures through the closed windows are not readable.
dialogue: Malcolm, desde el automóvil: Llegamos.
Pansy, desde el automóvil: ¿Ya?

panels.scene: On sidewalk after parking, Malcolm in charcoal coat with rectangular glasses stands at the driver's door, with Pansy smiling from the side of the car. House entry with pine wreath behind. No baby in this framing.
dialogue: Malcolm: Mañana puedo enseñarte el motor.
Pansy: Esperaba que lo ofrecieras.

pages.summary: Pansy descubre la casa sin magia, los recuerdos de Hermione y la calidez de los Granger.

panels.scene: Interior view toward dark green front door. Malcolm holds it open, one family arrives from the cold, Jane holding one Robin comfortably, Pansy and Hermione step onto oak floor and a rug. Rich natural lamp light and simple wood trim.
panels.caption: Adentro olía a cedro, libros y canela.

panels.scene: Wide low warm shot of the sitting room, glowing fireplace, gray-green sofa and two armchairs, stacked books, oak shelves and family photographs. Pansy in charcoal and dark green scarf gazes around from the right.
panels.caption: La casa era más cálida de lo que Pansy había imaginado.

panels.scene: Close oak bookshelf with two visible frames. One photo shows young Hermione clothed in school cardigan holding an unlettered certificate. The other shows a small young Hermione on Malcolm's shoulders beside a tree. Adult Pansy's face reflected softly in frame glass, if clear. Do not confuse child Hermione with present Hermione.
dialogue: Hermione, fuera de cuadro: Puedes inspeccionar las fotografías humillantes después.

panels.scene: In the sitting room Hermione has removed coat and scarf and wears burgundy knit with blue sapphire on platinum chain. She stands by Pansy, who points at a dark blank television. Unlit screen, no supernatural images.
dialogue: Pansy: ¿Qué es eso?
Hermione: Un televisor. Te lo enseñaré después.

panels.scene: Jane in sage cardigan and ivory blouse seated in one armchair with Robin upright and safely supported. Malcolm in charcoal coat and navy plaid scarf kneels next to the armchair and offers one index finger. Robin closes a tiny hand around it. The man's face shows a quiet smile.
dialogue: Malcolm: Parece que alguien está contento de haber llegado.

panels.scene: Jane stands beside oak stairs with Robin snug in her arms. Malcolm with his coat still on looks back from beside the two large trunks and one small trunk. Pansy and Hermione turn toward Jane.
dialogue: Jane: Pansy, cariño, ven conmigo. Te mostraré tu habitación.
